messages:
Maya: quick heads-up  I'm assembling the release notes for the next docs publish  includes the adaptive routing feature announcement and a migration guide for teams that pin model variants. Need: updated SDK snippets (py/ts/go), a short migration checklist, and a Known Issues bullet with repro steps.
Raj: on it. i'll scan python & curl examples for breaking changes. drop the PR link so i can comment inline?
Maya: PR here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4826  draft branch `release/2024-05-adaptive-routing`. please comment directly in the PR.
Sophia: i'll take TS + Go snippets. note: `retry_policy` was renamed to `fallback_policy` in runtime  i'll update samples accordingly.
Lee: found two broken anchors in the migration guide: `#pin-models` and `#kv-cache-behavior`. i'll add tiny redirect anchors in the doc and push to the PR unless you'd rather separate.
Raj: the python snippet fails tests because `fallback_policy` expects an object, not a string. propose updating example to:

```
client.generate(model="kestrel-1", input="hi", fallback_policy={"type": "model_variant", "priority": ["fast", "cheap"]})
```

Maya: perfect. also want a concise Known Issues note: "short bursts may see degraded latency under mixed sequence lengths; enable prefix cache for stable p99." can someone write a one-line repro with steps?
Sophia: i'll add TS repro steps: 1) stage runtime, 2) send one long context (4k tokens) then 8 parallel short prompts, 3) observe p99 spike. will paste snippet into PR.
Lee: adding a Dedicated rollouts note  customers on Reserved Capacity may see different fallback behavior due to pool pinning. adding that to the rollout section.
Raj: also noticed embed-streaming deprecation copy still referenced in a few pages. suggest a short cross-link callout in the release notes. i'll add it.
Maya: yes include a "behavior change" callout linking to the deprecation doc; keep it terse.
Dev-docs-bot: New comment added to PR #4826 by Sophia: "TS repro snippet added  needs QA verification on staging docs site." :robot_face:
Raj: QA plan: i'll run the updated python snippet against staging runtime tomorrow and report token counts + latency numbers.
Maya: final checklist: 1) changelog bullet for Console rollouts, 2) parity across SDK snippets, 3) migration checklist with step numbers. aim to merge by EOD tomorrow.
Lee: drafting a 3-step migration checklist and will drop into bottom of migration doc now.
Sophia: small nit: link text for "model variants" should go to model catalog page instead of model internals  fixed that in the PR.
Raj: replaced a few raw github urls with docs-relative permalinks to avoid rot. pushed that change.
Maya: anyone see blockers? please add approvals in the PR once you're comfortable. i'll schedule publish + Slack announcement after merge. :tada:
